headline: Colts move closer with a big gain
what_happened: D.Jones threw a pass to J.Downs for 11 yards, and a penalty on J.Hicks gave the Colts two extra yards.
who: D.Jones, J.Downs, and J.Hicks were involved in this play.
why_it_matters: This is bad news for the Chiefs because it keeps the Colts' drive alive, and their chances of winning have gone up by 7 percentage points.
